title: Capacitor (mobile)
description: Android/iOS app. Develop in the browser like the Vite template, then run the build on a phone.
nextSteps: npm run file-server   # in one terminal (serves scene files)
npm run dev           # in another; add ?editor to the URL for the scene editor
npx cap add android   # once (or ios, which needs macOS + Xcode)
npm run android       # build and run on a connected phone or emulator
